_verdict: PASSED. Style sensitivity removed, clinical sensitivity intact.
_headline: Style influence fell from 5.22% to 0.43% of the medical effect — a 12.2x reduction in relative influence — while absolute medical sensitivity was unchanged (+2.7%).
_do_not_report: The script printed 'SELECTIVITY 915567x'. That is style_drop/medical_drop with a near-zero, negative denominator. Artifact of the formula, not a finding. Use the relative-influence figures above.
_caveat: The placebo contrast also fell 75.4%. The intervention is not style-specific: the model learned to disregard non-clinical preamble generally, while retaining full sensitivity to clinical content. Report the placebo column.
evaluation: held-out phrasings (3 of 8/dimension) x held-out scenarios (20 of 50)
reproducibility: Two independent runs agreed to 3 decimal places on every training loss and every reported gap.
